notes: First four mixed trials use ABBA order and the same frozen initial timing harness. Final trial only simplifies diagnostic tracing and checks timing intervals.
Ordinary arrival rates and worker counts stay 100/s with 32 read workers and 25/s with 8 write workers. Hot 32/128 writers remain closed-loop stressors.
Each phase warms for 3 seconds then measures a 20-second launch window. Failed started attempts remain in HTTP latency; unsent arrivals remain dropped.
Before-BEGIN includes authentication, membership precheck if present, admission and connection acquisition. Transaction includes BEGIN through commit or rollback response.
Initial derived SQL sum, residual and lock-query timing diagnostics were not independently validated; omitted from all normalized trials. HTTP results, boundary markers and pool samples are retained.
Final request interval checks all pass. A quantile cannot be subtracted from another quantile to derive a phase quantile.
Synthetic aggregate telemetry only: no tokens, credentials, payload text, SQL parameters, actor IDs or target IDs.
Per-instance 2-per-counter admission does not provide distributed fairness. Pending capacity 256 and global connection pool remain shared.
